name: United Kingdom
eligible_citizens: Commonwealth citizens with leave to remain or indefinite leave
registration_steps: Register online at gov.uk/register-to-vote (takes about 5 minutes)
Provide your National Insurance number and date of birth
Select the type of vote: in person, by post, or by proxy
Deadline: usually 12 working days before an election
You must register at your current address
If you move, re-register at your new address
voting_steps: Find your polling station using your Poll Card or at gov.uk
Since May 2023, you MUST bring a valid photo ID to vote
Accepted IDs: Passport, driving licence, Blue Badge, certain electoral identity documents
Go to your polling station on election day (7am - 10pm)
Give your name and address to polling station staff
Show your photo ID to staff
Go to a polling booth and mark your choice with an X
Fold the ballot and place it in the ballot box
approved_ids: Older Person's Bus Pass (funded by the government)
notes: Photo ID is now required to vote in person in Great Britain (introduced 2023). Apply for a free Voter Authority Certificate if you don't have accepted ID.
